meta.label: Spatial figure eight
meta.description: A smooth three-dimensional figure eight with varying translational direction and height.
meta.position_note: Absolute position and yaw are unobservable. Positions are raw observer states, not gauge-aligned ground truth. Use body-frame velocity/gravity errors and reduced tilt to assess the proved convergence. The group position error may tend to a nonzero constant. No stochastic covariance interpretation is assigned to P.
